item.title: Pakistan, Saudi, Turkiye activate Mecca defence pact as Yemen war escalates
item.description: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye have agreed to enhance military cooperation to address regional security threats. The emergency meeting of the Mecca Defence Alliance in Riyadh led to this commitment. Saudi-backed forces are also launching an offensive against the Houthis in Yemen to regain control. item.title: Flydubai co-pilot originally planned attack for July, investigators believe
item.description: Police and security agencies in multiple countries scramble to piece together background and intentions of Hamam al-Hammami Investigators believe the co-pilot who tried to take control of a plane from Dubai to Tel Aviv last week originally planned his attack for July but postponed the hijacking, possibly because a friend was among the crew, regional and Israeli officials have said. The evidence of prior planning suggests that Hamam al-Hammami, 29, may have specifically sought employment with an airline that flew to Israel in order to carry out the attack on last Wednesday’s flydubai ‌flight… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Whether it's banning books or preventing artists from touring, silencing often backfires
item.description: If the goal was to silence rapper Macklemore by preventing him from touring with singer Ed Sheeran, it clearly backfired.
